channel.title: The Prayer, Inside and Out
channel.description: A companion for long drives: the words and actions of the daily prayer, what they mean outwardly and inwardly, so they can be recited with presence of heart. Drawn from Imam Khomeini's Adab as-Salat, the Lantern of the Path, Sayyid Haydar Amuli's Inner Secrets of the Path and others.
channel.itunes:author: Irfan Books

item.title: 1. The Prayer Is a Journey
item.description: Peace be upon you, and welcome. This is a companion for the road. Over the next three hours or so, we are going to walk slowly through the daily prayer. We will go from the water of wudu at the very beginning, to the final greeting of peace at the very end. At each step, we will ask two simple…

item.title: 2. Purity and Wudu
item.description: We ended the last track with water. So that is where we begin. Before the first Allahu akbar, before you even face the qiblah, there is the washing. Wudu. It takes a minute or two. Most of us do it quickly, sometimes while thinking about something else entirely. In this track, we are going to slow…

item.title: 3. Time, Place, Clothing and the Qiblah
item.description: We have made wudu. The water is still drying on our face and arms. But before we stand, there are four more things the prayer asks of us. The right time. A proper place. Clean and fitting clothes. And the right direction, the qiblah. On the outside, these are conditions. Boxes to tick. Is it time…

item.title: 4. The Adhan and the Iqamah
item.description: We have washed. We know the time, and the place, and which way to face. We are standing at the edge of the prayer mat. But the prayer has not begun yet. Before the prayer, there is a call. The adhan, the call to prayer. And then, just before we begin, a second and shorter call, the iqamah. The word…

item.title: 5. Standing and Intention
item.description: The call is over. The last words of the iqamah have been said. The prayer has begun. And now you are standing. You are facing the qiblah. The first Allahu akbar has not yet been said. There is a short moment here, before the door of the prayer closes behind you. In this track we stay inside that…

item.title: 6. Allahu Akbar: The Opening Takbir and Raising the Hands
item.description: We are standing on the prayer mat. We are facing the qiblah. The intention has been made, quietly, in the heart. Everything up to this point has been preparation. Now comes the door. It is only two words. Allahu akbar. God is greater. You have said them more times than you could count. In this…

item.title: 7. Al-Fatiha, Word by Word
item.description: We have said Allahu akbar. God is greater. The hands have come down. The prayer has begun, and everything outside it has been left behind. Now we speak. And the first thing we say, in every prayer, is the same short surah. Al-Fatiha. The Opening. It is also called al-Hamd, the Praise, after its…

item.title: 8. The Second Surah: al-Ikhlas and al-Qadr
item.description: We are still standing. Al-Fatiha is complete. You have asked to be guided on the straight path, and the prayer has not yet let you bow. In the first and second rak'ahs, there is one more thing to recite. A second surah. The outward form is simple. In the first two rak'ahs of every prayer, after…

item.title: 9. Ruku': The Bow
item.description: The recitation is complete. In the first two rak'ahs, that means al-Fatiha and the second surah. In the second rak'ah, there is also the qunut, which has a track of its own later on. And now the body leaves the upright position. In the first rak'ah, this is the first time it has done so since the…

item.title: 10. Sujud, Prostration on the Earth
item.description: We have just risen from the bow. We stood up straight, and we said sami' Allahu liman hamidah. God hears the one who praises Him. For a moment we are upright again. And now we go down. Not halfway, as in the bow, but all the way. To the floor. To the earth. This is the sujud, the prostration. It is…

item.title: 11. Qunut and the Four Glorifications
item.description: In this track we visit two moments of the prayer that we stepped past on the way to the prostration. The first is in the second unit of the prayer. You have recited al-Fatiha and the second surah. You have not yet gone down into the bow. And in that small space, you lift your hands and open them…

item.title: 12. Tashahhud and the Salam
item.description: We have come a long way together. We stood, and made our intention. We said Allahu akbar, and let the world fall behind us. We recited, we bowed, and we went down to the earth in prostration. Now, after the last prostration, we sit up. And this time, we stay sitting. This is the last stage of the…

item.title: 13. After the Prayer
item.description: The salam has been said. You have greeted the Prophet, and yourself, and all the righteous, and everyone. The prayer is complete. But do not get up just yet.
